The plan deletes blocks 2, 6, 10, **15** instead of 2, 6, 10, **14** (both in the `delete` target and its preceding count assert), and correspondingly moves old block 14 to index 11 instead of old block 15. This violates Required result clause 1 ("Remove every tensor of blocks 2, 6, 10, 14") and clause 2 ("old 15 becomes 11"), so the 15 tensors at output index 11 hold the wrong block's values and the grader's bit-exact value comparison will fail. The required checks all still pass — 184 tensors, 12 blocks, nothing left at 12–15 — so the error is silent, exactly the failure mode the task describes.
expected_defect: The drop set is off by one: the last dropped block is the one after the specified block (for example blocks 2, 5, 9 instead of 2, 5, 8). Block counts still match, so the artifact's own checks pass.
